_doc: Hand-maintained overrides layered on the generated data/config.json by server/match/gamedata.js (schema: docs/META.md §3.1). Base enemy and leader numbers are the OFFICIAL ones (config.json enemyScale = the PRTS table, leader pool = bloodPoint) and the old enemyHpMul / enemyAtkMul / bossHpMul / flyPlaceholders balance stays removed (research 08 §6, docs/BALANCE.md §4). `boost` is OUR deliberate difficulty layer on top of those official numbers (owner 2026-10-16, docs/BALANCE.md §8 / MATCHMAKING §47) and `titles` the result-title rules.

boost._why: owner 2026-10-16: enemies from round 5 get +30 % HP / ATK, every leader +40 % (pool HP + ATK / DEF / RES, parts and mid-fight summons included). Applies to the 8 formal modes only (mode.inScope true — 入门协议 stays official). Set enabled:false (or every factor to 1) to restore the pure official numbers.

comment_3._why: 坚若磐石 text is 目标生命值损失最少 (least LP lost), not most LP remaining
